patch.sql: INSERT INTO catalog_texts ("id","value") SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]') FROM json_each(?) WHERE 1 ON CONFLICT ("id") DO UPDATE SET "value"=excluded."value"

INSERT INTO catalog_codes ("code","product_id","category_id","is_current") SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]'),json_extract(value,'$[2]'),json_extract(value,'$[3]') FROM json_each(?) WHERE 1 ON CONFLICT ("code") DO UPDATE SET "product_id"=excluded."product_id","category_id"=excluded."category_id","is_current"=excluded."is_current"

INSERT INTO catalog_aliases ("namespace","identifier","product_id") SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]'),json_extract(value,'$[2]') FROM json_each(?) WHERE 1 ON CONFLICT ("namespace","identifier") DO UPDATE SET "product_id"=excluded."product_id"

INSERT INTO catalog_records ("product_id","kind","payload") SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]'),json_extract(value,'$[2]') FROM json_each(?) WHERE 1 ON CONFLICT ("product_id","kind") DO UPDATE SET "payload"=excluded."payload"

INSERT INTO catalog_discounts ("month","product_id","regular_price","sale_price") SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]'),json_extract(value,'$[2]'),json_extract(value,'$[3]') FROM json_each(?) WHERE 1 ON CONFLICT ("month","product_id") DO UPDATE SET "regular_price"=excluded."regular_price","sale_price"=excluded."sale_price"
INSERT INTO catalog_documents ("name","payload") SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]') FROM json_each(?) WHERE 1 ON CONFLICT ("name") DO UPDATE SET "payload"=excluded."payload"
DELETE FROM catalog_records WHERE ("product_id","kind") IN (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]') FROM json_each(?))
DELETE FROM catalog_assets WHERE ("product_id","kind") IN (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]') FROM json_each(?))
DELETE FROM catalog_prices WHERE ("product_id","kind") IN (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]') FROM json_each(?))
DELETE FROM catalog_discounts WHERE ("month","product_id") IN (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]') FROM json_each(?))
DELETE FROM catalog_products WHERE ("id") IN (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]') FROM json_each(?))
